zh: 行政院指派NCC代表人，優先處理航空器與船舶執照核發
en: Executive Yuan appoints NCC representative to prioritize aircraft and vessel licensing

zh: 一架Druine D.31飛機於英國航展表演時受損，飛行員重傷送醫。
en: A Druine D.31 Turbulent aircraft was damaged during a UK air show display, seriously injuring the pilot.

zh: 安哥拉航空順利完成載運兩隻成年獅子之特殊貨運任務
en: TAAG Angola Airlines transports two adult lions from South Africa to Nigeria

zh: 加拿大皇家空軍接收首架空中巴士H135直升機（CT-153 Juno）。
en: Royal Canadian Air Force receives its first Airbus H135 helicopter.

zh: 立榮申請停飛台北花蓮，花蓮國內航線恐全斷
en: Uni Air applies to suspend Taipei-Hualien; all Hualien domestic routes at risk

zh: 英航 A321neo 裝載前停機坪行李櫃起火
en: Baggage container catches fire near British Airways A321neo before pushback

zh: 澳洲政府批准雪梨機場2045年總體規劃，將打造單一綜合航廈。
en: Australian government approves Sydney Airport Master Plan 2045 for integrated terminal.

zh: 敘利亞航空恢復大馬士革至莫斯科定期航線，首班客機8月16日降落莫斯科。
en: Syrian Airlines resumes Damascus-Moscow flights following a 1.5-year suspension.

zh: 立榮與華信申請停飛花蓮航線 民航局審查中
en: UNI Air and Mandarin Airlines apply to suspend Hualien routes

zh: 華航連續4年獲亞洲最佳企業雇主獎「組織團隊」得高分
en: China Airlines wins Best Companies to Work for in Asia award for fourth straight year
